findings.desc: [HIGH] packages/main/src/handlers/doctor.ts:292-323 renders doctor repairCommand with JSON.stringify(path), so the suggested `git rm --cached -- "..."` snippet is not shell-safe. Double-quoted shell snippets still expand `$VAR`, `$(...)`, and backticks; `zsh -lc 'printf "%s\\n" ".koala-tmp-$(printf injected)"'` resolves to `.koala-tmp-injected`. That is reachable here because runtime-artifact-registry matches arbitrary `.koala-tmp-*` names (packages/main/src/core/runtime-artifact-registry.ts:83-86) and literal `$PROJECT_ROOT/` paths (119-122). The current smoke only asserts the simple `.koala/activity.jsonl` case (packages/main/src/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:275-293), so this regression is untested. Fix by rendering repair commands with POSIX-safe single-quote escaping (or by removing the pasteable shell snippet and pointing users to `koala doctor --repair`), and add a regression test covering metacharacters in tracked runtime-artifact paths.
